blind.description: A roasted wild boar head served on an oval silver platter. The boar head features reddish-brown cooked skin, visible tusks, and a red apple held in its snout. A decorative garland of green leaves and small red berries encircles the base of the head atop the rimmed metal serving dish. All geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled in a stylized video game aesthetic.
blind.from_above: An oval silver dish framing a roasted boar head looking downward, bordered by a wreath of green leaves interspersed with small round red berries.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 foot tall and 1.5 feet wide, roughly one-sixth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
